data.title: Amazon’s CEO, CFO and AWS Chief All Just Sold Amazon Stock
data.summary: Together they sold 64,848 shares worth about $16.6 million, at an average price of roughly $256. Every sale ran under a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan, which is a selling schedule set in advance that runs without the insider making day-to-day decisions. Amazon rose 3.47% to $255.39 on Monday, November 23, the day most of the selling happened. On Tuesday it went down 1.21% to $252.29, and it was quoted at $251.50 after hours at 7:59 p.m. ET. [...] Six insiders reported stock sales in Form 4s posted the evening of November 24, 2026. The sellers were Amazon (NASDAQ:AMZN) President and CEO Andy Jassy, CFO Brian Olsavsky and AWS CEO Matt Garman, along with senior vice president David Zapolsky, Worldwide Amazon Stores CEO Doug Herrington and vice president Shelley Reynolds. [...] So a $2.73 trillion company that is up 9.3% year to date and 11.49% over one year had its top three executives sell within a day of each other. Once you read the filings, the sales look much less worrying than that summary. What the Form 4s Show
